overviewMethod: Union of supplied source areas by waterplan; geographic overview only, not newly delineated drainage catchments.
boundaryRendering: Unique noded edges on a 1 m metric grid, simplified 40 m after dissolving. Shared major/minor edges belong to the major layer. Polygon files supply hover areas only.
streamSource: Existing supplied Dams named river/larger-creek extracts; partial coverage, not a complete stream network.
streamContinuity: Exact touching segments dissolved and line-merged by name; mixed-intersection linework retained. No endpoint snapping, buffering, bridging or inferred connections.
note: Water-plan areas are context, not verified upstream gauge catchments. Only supplied creek subcatchments are shown. Stream coverage is partial.
